slides.title:
Seven kinds
of mind
slides.subtitle: Your mind is one slice of a bigger one

slides.label: Rig Veda 10.90
slides.title:
The Moon was born
from a mind
body: The Purusha Sukta pictures the whole cosmos as one great Person. Of that Person it says: “The Moon was gendered from his mind.”
slides.closing: So the mind you use is a slice of a bigger one

slides.label: In your chart
slides.title: Twenty-seven slices
body: In your chart the Moon is the mind. Its road round the sky is cut into 27 stars, the nakshatras, and at your birth the Moon stood in one of them. That star is your slice.
slides.closing: Each star has four quarters: a slice of a slice

slides.label: The seven natures · Brihat Samhita, ch. 98
slides.title: Steady, moving, light

items.head: The steady mind
items.line: Builds what lasts. The texts pick these stars for foundations, planting and crowning kings.
items.sub: Rohini · Uttara Phalguni · Uttara Ashadha · Uttara Bhadrapada

items.head: The moving mind
items.line: Thinks on the move. Picked for trips and anything that travels.

items.head: The light mind
items.line: Quick hands, quick study. Picked for trade, learning, craft and medicine.

slides.label: The seven natures · Brihat Samhita, ch. 98
slides.title: Soft and fierce

items.head: The soft mind
items.line: Warm and tactful. Picked for friendship, music, clothes and celebrations.

items.head: The fierce mind
items.line: Heat and nerve. Picked for battles and for breaking what must go.
items.sub: Bharani · Magha · Purva Phalguni · Purva Ashadha · Purva Bhadrapada

slides.label: The seven natures · Brihat Samhita, ch. 98
slides.title: Sharp, and both at once

items.head: The sharp mind
items.line: Cuts to the root. Picked for cutting ties, strict discipline and mantra work.

items.head: The soft-and-sharp mind
items.line: Gentle and cutting by turns. The texts call its results mixed.

slides.note: The texts sort the stars this way to choose a day for a task. Reading them as kinds of mind is Sutram’s reading.

slides.label: For example
slides.title: Two sharp minds

items.head: Mula, the root
items.line: A mind that digs. It keeps asking why until it reaches the bottom of a thing.

items.head: Ardra, the moist one
items.line: Moist, like the ground after rain. A mind that feels the storm fully, then starts fresh.

slides.note: Sutram’s reading, from the stars’ names and their nature

slides.label: In real life
slides.title:
A moving mind
thinks on its feet
items: It plans and works on the move
Its best ideas come on a walk
slides.note: Moon in Punarvasu, Swati, Shravana, Dhanishta or Shatabhisha

slides.label: In real life
slides.title: Work with the grain
items: A steady mind studies best at one desk: give it time
A light mind learns by doing: give it short tasks
A sharp mind wants the real reason: say it straight

slides.title:
Which kind of mind
is yours?
